Class CommitAttempt

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.sdk.modeling.CommitAttempt
public final class CommitAttempt extends Object
Internal state of one model commit attempt, from its loaded begin-state through ordered changes and completion. Instances used only as a handler read context leave the evaluation and completion portions empty.
